text:
marta: Heads-up from nightly eval: q4_1-quantized build shows high fail rate on structured-output prompt set — many JSON responses truncated, parse errors up from 0.8% -> 9.3%. Attaching eval-bot summary.
eval-bot: nightly-eval: model=q4_1-quantized; promptset=structured-schema-check; total=5k; fail=466 (9.32%); median_latency=83ms; top_failure='truncated_json'
cheng: ack. can you paste an example?
marta: example JSON where closing braces missing, ends with ...'answer': 'The model thinks'
marta: ```json
{'id':123,'answer':'The model thinks'
```
sam: interesting — does this coincide with packed-KV change from last deploy? infra-bot?
lia: also seeing increase in length mismatch on streaming tokens; sometimes final eos token missing.
infra-bot: deployment 2026-03-19T02:10Z: packed-kv v2.3 applied to runtime pool-a
cheng: ok root suspects: quant kernel change causing early termination or KV eviction leading to truncated generation. Steps to triage?
sam: run model locally on failing prompts with kv_debug=True and compare logits near end.
marta: I ran one: observed abrupt drop in next-token prob mass at token N leading to premature stop. Logs attached.
cheng: can you share logits snippet?
marta: ```log
... token_idx=47 prob=0.0012
... token_idx=48 prob=1e-8 (sudden)
... stop
```
lia: could be numerical underflow from int8 kernel fused op; ask eng-runtime to repro with higher FP guard.
cheng: pinging @eng-runtime
cheng: @eng-runtime any known issues with last quant kernel that may zero out softmax tails?
eng-runtime: haven't seen this in unit runs; will run with failing prompts. Also suspect batching boundary condition in streaming flush.
deploy-bot: canary-rollout: q4_1-quantized -> pool-canary-3 (10%) started
sam: please pause canary until we confirm — can exacerbate failure.
marta: request: pause canary and rollback canary to previous model (q4_1-quantized:v20260315)
infra-bot: canary paused
cheng: triage plan: (1) repro locally with kv_debug + fp64 guard, (2) run eval with deterministic rng, (3) add targeted unit test for structured-output prompts, (4) block gating rule until fixed.
lia: I'll add a gating rule to nightly: if structured-schema-check fail rate >2% then fail gate.
marta: temporary mitigation: fallback policy to q4_1-fp16 (non-quant) for requests tagged with output_schema=structured until fix.
sam: create rollback ticket and change log + alert for customers on dedicated capacity?
marta: created ticket RFC-4821. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RFC-4821
cheng: root cause hypothesis: int8 softmax tails underflow + batching flush bug -> early EOS-like token selection. Action items assigned.
marta: owners: eng-runtime (cheng), eng-ml (marta, sam), infra (lia). Timeline: hotfix in 24-48h, gate enforced immediately.
eng-runtime: running reproducer now. logs will be in /tmp/q4_trunc_repro.log
marta: after repro, we updated kernel: guard added to softmax exp accumulation; test run passed 5k prompts, fail 0.2%. will stage patch to canary with increased telemetry.
deploy-bot: canary-rollout: q4_1-quantized-patch -> pool-canary-3 (10%) started
lia: updated gating rule and added alert to PagerDuty: PD-struct-json
sam: recommend backfill eval for past week to catch regressions earlier.
marta: agreed. also adding a lightweight structured-schema unit to pre-merge CI.
cheng: closing loop: rollback performed -> canary paused -> patch staged -> gating enforced -> follow-up postmortem scheduled.
marta: :thumbsup: thanks all. will post postmortem with artifacts + reproducer.
